answer: Mechanism: deposit + arbitration forfeiture. Before voting/grading, every identity must deposit 500 USDC in escrow, submit a cipher (AES-256-GCM encrypted device attestation) from a Lantern HSM, and send a signed 1-Hz pulse as a liveness heartbeat to the contract. Attack: a farm of 1000 clones pays 1000×$500=$500,000 locked, then one arbitration audit detects the shared payout-address pattern and forfeits all 1000 deposits. Honesty stays cheaper.
